what_it_is: Per-burst complex gain modulation at gain 89 (433/915 MHz): g_j = 1 + amp * exp(j(2 pi freq_hz j / f_burst + phase)), phase at the run's first burst set by phase_rad / phase_sd_rad (not random: the modulation starts with the transmission). Transmit-side: unchanged when the level into the BB60 drops ~20 dB (D:/gain_experiment). Fleet-common: same frequency on all 24 radios and both sessions (July/August), size within ~+-10 %. Not a fingerprint.
measurement: Per-burst complex gain of each burst against the run average, strongest line in +-20 Hz at the burst rate; amp = |complex amplitude| (half the peak-to-peak gain swing). July training sessions only: 24 radios x runs [2, 7].
frequency_note: Frequencies are as seen at the burst rate; a true frequency of 766.28*k + f cannot be excluded, but a per-burst gain that large rules out k != 0 averaging within a 1.3 ms burst.
absent: 89_2400 and every gain-77 config: no consistent line (< 0.8 % peak-to-peak, random frequency).
b_amp_note: b_amp = median |complex line amplitude| of the per-burst change of the cubic, from the July clean-PA model of each radio (linearised around b0), same runs.
phase_note: phase_rad / phase_sd_rad: start phase of the modulation at the run's first burst, circular mean / sd over the training runs (analysis_scripts/measure_pa_mod_phase.py); the generator draws it per run
tap_swing_note: tap_swing: the ISI taps (relative to the main tap) swing with the modulation, taps_j = taps + c * r_j on the data portion, r_j the gain-step phasor; fleet median over the training radios, burst average with the BB60 passband divided out (analysis_scripts/measure_pa_mod_cubic.py fleet)
